text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital and I are hashing out our plans for the future, when…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, I'm fine! My head just hurts a little.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I've got the worst writer's block right now. Like, I can't decide what to do for my next fic at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You see, I happened across two Umamusume at the infirmary earlier…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The older student carried the younger one in her arms! And they were alone in the infirmary, just the two of them—the younger one whimpering weakly while the other one comforted her…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But as soon as I begin thinking of the many ways that scene could develop I—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gyah… owwwww! There it goes again, the second I start daydreaming…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So she's got headaches from… an overworked imagination? I have no idea how that works, but it ends up bothering her for the rest of the day.
